description: Dataset for Power System Reliability Analysis Using a 6-bus Network is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Iver Bakken Sperstad, Ivar Bjerkebæk (SINTEF Energy Research). This is the dataset for the reliability test system used in a research article submitted to the Power Systems Computational Conference 2024, please go to readme.md for description of files. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
